faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about our services and trading platform.

items.question: Is Your Company fully licensed?
items.answer: Yes, we are regulated by the the relevant regulator and are fully compliant with applicable regulations.

items.question: What markets can I trade on?
items.answer: You can trade on the LSE, AIM, NYSE, NASDAQ, and several other global markets.

items.question: How much does it cost to open an account?
items.answer: Opening an account is completely free. There are no setup fees or minimum deposit requirements.

items.question: What if I need help with my investments?
items.answer: Every client gets a dedicated advisor. You can also access our 24/7 support via phone, email, or live chat.

items.question: How are my funds protected?
items.answer: Client funds are held in segregated trust accounts with major partner banks and protected by the FSCS up to $85,000.

items.question: Do you offer a mobile app?
items.answer: Yes, we have a fully featured mobile app for iOS and Android – trade, track, and manage your portfolio on the go.

items.question: What educational resources do you provide?
items.answer: We offer a library of articles, video tutorials, weekly webinars, and daily market commentary to help you invest wisely.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.text: At Your Company, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you interact with our website and services in accordance with the applicable privacy laws.
1. Information We Collect
We may collect the following types of personal information:

items: Name and contact details (email, phone, address)
Date of birth and government ID number (for account opening)
Device and usage data from our website and app

sections.text: 2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:

items: Process your account application and transactions
Provide personalised financial advice and support
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations (e.g., AML, regulatory requirements)
Improve our products and services through analytics

sections.text: 3. Data Security
We implement industry‑standard security measures, including encryption and access controls, to protect your data from unauthorised access or disclosure.

sections.title: Note
sections.text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time by contacting us at privacy@example.com.
4. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please email us at privacy@example.com or call +44 20 8000 1234.

sections.text: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the Your Company website, mobile app, and trading platform. By using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms.
1. Acceptance of Terms
By creating an account or using our platform, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accept these terms. If you do not agree, please refrain from using our services.
2. User Obligations

items: Maintain the security of your login credentials
Not use the platform for illegal activities
Comply with all applicable UK laws and regulations

sections.text: 3. Risk Disclaimer

Trading in financial markets carries significant risk. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Your Company does not guarantee any investment outcomes and strongly recommends seeking independent advice before making investment decisions.
4. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Your Company is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our platform, including but not limited to trading losses, system failures, or data breaches.
5. Changes to Terms
We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or through our platform. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy

sections.text: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can manage your preferences when visiting the Your Company website in compliance with applicable cookie laws.
1. What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences, analyse website traffic, and improve your user experience.
2. Types of Cookies We Use

items.definition: Necessary for core functionality such as logging in, security, and session management. These cannot be disabled.
Help us understand how visitors interact with our site, which pages are popular, and how we can improve performance.
Used to deliver relevant advertisements and track the effectiveness of our campaigns. We only use these with your consent.

sections.text: 3. Managing Your Preferences
You can control cookie settings through your browser or our cookie consent tool. Blocking certain cookies may affect your experience on our site.

sections.title: Important
sections.text: We respect your privacy and only use cookies that are necessary for the proper functioning of our platform. For any questions, contact us at privacy@example.com.
